attributes.name: continuous
attributes.description: Requests multiple recognition results in one session.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables editing and recognition and stops any active session.

attributes.name: interim-results
attributes.description: Displays provisional recognition separately from the final transcript.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Final transcript, editable without microphone access.

methods.name: abort(): void
methods.description: Cancels recognition, discarding provisional text but retaining final text.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Clears the transcript after cancelling active recognition.

methods.name: start(): void
methods.description: Starts recognition after an explicit user action; never retries automatically.

methods.name: stop(): void
methods.description: Stops listening while allowing the browser to deliver a final result.

events.description: Emitted when recognition ends or is aborted.

events.name: tp-speech-to-text-error
events.description: Emitted when recognition fails or is unavailable.

events.name: tp-speech-to-text-result
events.description: Emitted when recognition updates its transcript.

userHelp.introduction: The custom **`<tp-speech-to-text>`** element implements the speech-to-text functionality: transcribes microphone speech into editable text using the Web Speech API.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Start | Request microphone access and begin listening. |
| Stop | Stop listening and let the browser finalize the transcript. |
| Clear | Cancel listening and remove the transcript. |
| Transcript | Click to edit finalized text. Provisional text may change while you speak. |
| Status | Read permission or service errors. Recognition depends on the browser and may send audio to an online service. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the available controls. |
| Enter / Space | Activate the focused button. |
| Typing in the transcript | Edit the recognized text. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |

keyboard.description: Moves between playback controls and the transcript field.
